summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adjusting the conversion factor for visitor data in Belgium. Initially, [p1] questioned whether a proposed factor of 19 should be applied to production or staging environments. [p3] advised against changing the factor and suggested that dwell time analysis (estimated at 22-29 minutes) with a mall factor (around 5-6) would yield more logical numbers.

Ultimately, it was decided to wait for manual counting results before making any changes to the current data factors.
decisions: Wait until manual counting is completed before adjusting the Belgium visitor data factor.
